entry.summary: Visa-free for 30 days via Minsk airport. Restrictions apply.
entry.note: First-pass triage carried from Australian World Travel; recheck against the official source.

consular.notes: Australia doesn't have an embassy in Belarus. Contact the Australian Embassy in Russia for consular help. Our ability to provide consular assistance is severely limited. The Australian Government will not be able to evacuate you from Belarus.

sources.title: Belarus travel advice: consular contacts
